## How I checked it

- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test` pass
- [ ] I played the change in the browser (`npm run dev`), including what the player actually sees afterwards (not just the numbers)
- [ ] New strings are added in both `src/i18n/zh-TW.ts` and `src/i18n/en.ts`
- [ ] Commit messages start with `[new]`, `[fix]`, `[enhance]` or `[doc]`
